category_title: Disruptive student-teacher who publicly challenges instructor authority
scenario_title: Post-exam grade complaint and boundary testing
minimal_context: The student is communicating via email to review her exam performance and request a personal meeting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your exam has been graded. You received a score of 73.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am writing this e-mail because I do not understand why I got such a low grade.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The grade is based on the course rubric.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am rebelling against the style of the course! I am not even listening to the context in which things were said.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What would you like to do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to sit and read the exam with you. (Acting as the typical opponent and trying to have an effect on her environment)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Your exam has been graded. You received a score of 73.

STUDENT: I am writing this e-mail because I do not understand why I got such a low grade.

TUTOR: The grade is based on the course rubric.

STUDENT: I am rebelling against the style of the course! I am not even listening to the context in which things were said.

TUTOR: What would you like to do next?

STUDENT: I want to sit and read the exam with you. (Acting as the typical opponent and trying to have an effect on her environment)

task.content: Reviewing her performance on the course exam and requesting a personal meeting to discuss the results.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Taking the exam and getting a 73.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Wrote an e-mail saying that she did not understand why she got such a low grade and that she wanted to sit and read the exam with the lecturer.

behavior_patterns.condition: General behavior pattern during the 12-week semester-long academic course.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Behaved as a rebel. She rebelled against the style of the course without even listening to the context in which things were said. As the typical opponent, she spoke loudly and tried to have an effect on her environment.
